- Downloads: the torrent engine (6 MB) has a button at the top of the Downloads page as long as it is not on the phone, so a torrent download that waits for it can be started from there (before, the button was only on the failed row, and it did not show for every failure). A torrent download waiting for the engine goes on by itself once it is here.
- Downloads: a torrent that gets nothing from anyone within a minute and a half gives way to another stream of the same episode, the closest in size (up to five are kept with each download, the ones nobody shares last); the first pick also prefers a stream someone shares.
- Downloads: long press a row and slide the finger over the others to pick them all, as in Files (the list follows at the edges); the picked frame and the bar at the bottom slide in instead of jumping; the bar has an All button that picks every row shown (or none again).
- Download manager settings: "Keep the file when removed" (off at first): removing a finished download then only takes it off the list and the file stays on the phone.
- Home screen icons: the cyan glass colour is now the soft blue of the One UI glass theme icons, so Pulse and the extra apps sit with the phone's own icons. The icon chooser shows the real icons (the line one and every glass colour) instead of words, and App icons has a row that changes every home screen icon at once, above the apps one by one.
- Keyboard: fifteen key-press effects in Settings > Effects, each with a moving preview: five around the pressed key (Ring, Sparks, Ripple, Halo, Stars), five across the whole keyboard (Wave, Flash, Edge, Sweep, Rings) and five dark styles (Neon, Ember, Snow, Matrix, Smoke).
- Keyboard: a video that has just been downloaded shows in the right slot of the bar like a new picture does, as its own small picture with a little black play mark on it; a tap pastes it into a field that takes videos.
